features.statement: Document title appends a descriptive tagline after the brand name, separated by an en dash.
Page uses semantic landmarks (header, main, article, section) and h3 headings for card titles rather than generic containers.
Hero uses a diagonal blue gradient background instead of flat color.
Navigation is a separate white bar above the hero with dark text and right-aligned links, including an outlined language button.
Logo is a two-tone wordmark with a blue accent word and a small SVG icon.
Headings are large, bold (700) and title case, using the system-ui font stack with larger body text of 16px.
Search field is a narrower rounded input in a shadowed white container with the button inset inside.
Input placeholder gives an instructive example format, such as 'Enter your domain, e.g. example.com'.
Suggested links appear as translucent rounded pill chips on the hero.
Feature blocks are bordered white cards with left-aligned text, small rounded-square tinted icon tiles and bold titles.
Section headers are a plain bold heading paired with a blue text link ending in an arrow.
Metric values are color-coded by score level (green, orange, red) and shown at uniform size.
Cards have rounded corners with the image flush at the top, and medium 8–15px radii are used widely.
Missing images show a grey 'No preview available' placeholder instead of a broken image.
Image alt text is descriptive, prefixed with 'Screenshot of' before the name.
About section is a standalone white section above the footer, with the copyright on a full-width bottom row under a divider.
Layout is built with CSS grid and flexbox, with few classes and inline styles.
Page background is a very light blue-grey tint rather than pure white.
Text is dark navy with a vivid Tailwind-style blue accent color.
Hero subtitle is a plain sans-serif sentence-case paragraph, not a heading, and the hero is compact.
Only the system font stack is used, with no web or icon fonts loaded.
Headings and labels use title case throughout, without uppercase transforms.
Head contains minimal meta tags: charset, viewport and description only.
